title: incident-bot: add SLO-toolkit utilities for enriched oncall diagnostics and runbook linking
author: Priya Singh
description:
Motivation: oncall workflows lacked contextual SLO and runbook bindings in diagnostics cards, requiring engineers to manually correlate alerts with runbooks and SLO context. This PR introduces a set of SLO-toolkit utilities and incident-bot integrations to enrich oncall diagnostics with: 1) SLO metadata extraction (service, objective, burn rate hints), 2) prioritized runbook linking based on SLI/SLO tags and recent incident history, and 3) compact oncall helper cards for quick remediation commands.

What changed: added new utilities to the slo-toolkit used by incident-bot for SLO lookups and scoring, a runbook linker that suggests top-runbooks with rationale, and a small refactor to incident-bot diagnostics rendering to surface enriched context. The description below enumerates the deliverables and rationale.

Deliverables: - slo-toolkit/src/telemetry/enrichment.py: SLO metadata extractor and scoring heuristics (tag matching, recent-failure-weighting, service affinity). - incident-bot/src/handlers/runbook_linker.py: uses enrichment utilities to produce ranked runbook suggestions and compact links for oncall messages. - incident-bot/src/utils/slo_helpers.py: caching layer, TTLs, and fallbacks to ensure diagnostics path is latency-safe. - incident-bot/src/ui/compact_helper_cards.py: new compact card template for Slack/MS teams with one-click runbook open and suggested commands. - docs/oncall/runbooks.md: updated runbook linking conventions and scoring explanation. - tests: unit coverage for scoring heuristics and end-to-end handler tests.

Backward compatibility: default behavior is unchanged unless the new feature is enabled via incident-bot config flag ENABLE_SLO_TOOLKIT_ENRICHMENT. This allows gradual rollout (canary for small teams).

Performance & safety: enrichment does a best-effort background fetch and uses cached SLO metadata; we ensured the diagnostics path remains below 150ms P95 additional latency in local perf runs. There are fallbacks to omit SLO context if lookups fail or exceed timeout.

Related: Linear ENG-4123 covers the heuristics work; SUP-7891 tracks a customer request for runbook quicklinks in alerts.

Notes on testing and rollout: unit tests + integration tests added. Manual canary ran against staging oncall channels for 48h with no regressions. Feature gated behind runtime flag for controlled rollout.

Miguel Torres: The scoring weights feel aggressive for recent incidents; suggest softer decay. (addressed - reduced recent-failure weight from 0.6 to 0.4)
Ethan Park: Can we add telemetry counters for cache hit/miss and lookup latency? (added in slo_helpers and wired to telemetry)
Priya Singh: replied - added caching metrics and updated docs with rollout guidance.
Ava Chen: Approve after tests pass. (approved)
release_notes:
- incident-bot: optional SLO enrichment for diagnostics and prioritized runbook linking.
- slo-toolkit: added SLO metadata extraction and scoring utilities.
- oncall: compact helper cards for faster remediation.
Notes: feature is opt-in via ENABLE_SLO_TOOLKIT_ENRICHMENT; no breaking changes.
